component.name: Box Design
component.summary: Lay out controller enclosures and export DXF/PDF/STL

description.p: Box Design is a tool for laying out controller enclosures. Pick a box, drag controller boards and power supplies onto it, add screw holes and zip-tie slots, then export the result as DXF (for CNC/laser cutting), PDF (1:1 scale reference/print), or an STL/3MF solid plate for 3D printing.
